title: limit~

messages.description: set limiting amplitude threshold (in linear or dB)
set latency in ms (buffer size is half of this)

flags.name: -db
flags.description: sets amplitude limit in dB (default linear)

methods.description: set amplitude limit (in linear or dB)
set latency in ms (buffer size is half of this)
nonzero sets to dB amplitude mode

body: [limit~] performs look-ahead limiting, so it outputs with a latency defined by the 2nd argument or rightmost input. The buffer size for peak detection is half the latency time. This is based on SuperCollider's Limiter UGen.
